LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM • INCEST • BESTIALITY • PROSTITUTION • HOMOSEXUALITY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Prohibitions in Islam • incest • bestiality • prostitution • homosexuality
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 16

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Prohibitions in Islam • incest • bestiality • prostitution • homosexuality, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is deviant sexual behaviour on the rise in the society? 2. How can deviant sexual behaviour be reduced in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,

2. research on the causes of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,

3. discuss the effects of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) in the society in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint, learners with low vision can be supported to come up with charts using appropriate font size and colour contrast, while those with blindness can be given physical support as they make tactile charts,

4. watch or listen to video clips on the effects of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,

5. listen to a resource person explaining the causes, effects and rationale for 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,
2. research on the causes of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,
3. discuss the effects of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) in the society in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint, learners with low vision can be supported to come up with charts using appropriate font size and colour contrast, while those with blindness can be given physical support as they make tactile charts,
4. watch or listen to video clips on the effects of deviant sexual behaviour (incest, bestiality, prostitution, and homosexuality) and make notes,
5. listen to a resource person explaining the causes, effects and rationale for 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Prohibitions in Islam • incest • bestiality • prostitution • homosexuality together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication is enhanced as learners discuss the effects of deviant sexual

behaviour in the society in groups, and present on charts/PowerPoint.

• Communication and collaboration: teamwork is enhanced as learners contribute to the discussion on the effects of

deviant sexual behaviour in the society.

• Learning to learn: the skill of research is enhanced as learners research on the causes of deviant sexual behaviour

and make notes.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as learners research on the rationale for the prohibition of deviant sexual behaviour.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Awareness on health-related issues such as HIV and AIDS is enhanced as learners discuss the effects of deviant sexual

behaviour in the society.

Link to other subjects

Social studies and Life Skills Education as learners discuss the effects of deviant sexual behaviour in the society.
